question: India started working in space research with the launch of a meteorological rocket in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1963**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s journey in space research began in the year 1963__** with the launch of its first meteorological rocket from the Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station (TERLS) located near Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
 
• This marked the initiation of the Indian space program under the leadership of **Dr. Vikram Sarabhai**, who is regarded as the father of India’s space program. 
 
• The first sounding rocket launched was a **NASA-provided rocket named Nike-Apache**, which carried scientific instruments to study the upper atmosphere.
 
• The Thumba location was chosen because it is close to the geomagnetic equator, making it ideal for atmospheric studies.
